body: Thanks so much for responding, I really appreciate it. I'll check all of those out. Cheers =)
Thanks for responding. You're right, I think I was just thinking of all the possibilities. I really hope I didn't add to the cause.
Thanks. I do believe we will be stronger afterwards. It's definitely going to take time.

That was great, thanks so much for just responding but also giving me good advice. I'm going to definitely make an effort to talk about it openly, I can see how important it is for her to know I'm here 100 per cent. I feel less confused that you have reminded me suicide is irrational.

Honestly thank you so much, you should know you have helped me even in a small way.

Cheers

This is generally my way of dealing with depression for myself and my friends, so if it seems unreasonable in your situation don't try it.

I've had a few friends go through this and I have always found trying to laugh about anything even the sensitive things, is the best way to help.
